description: Pricing for the paid launch (MVP amendment, Step A). Every price point below is a null placeholder for the owner to fill in -- see PRICING_OPTIONS.md for the full comparison and reasoning. 'model' is set to the recommended option (per-document only, for the first paid launch); 'hybridSubscriptionAddOn' is left in the shape for later, not active, since the entitlements schema (Step B.1) already has room for it (nullable documentId) without a redesign. No price here has been picked from memory of competitors -- every priceUsd is null until the owner sets it.

perDocument._note: includedReexports/includedEditWindowDays are a concrete default proposed in PRICING_OPTIONS.md's 'What this leaves for the owner' section, not a pricing recommendation -- change freely.

hybridSubscriptionAddOn._note: Not active at launch. Reserved for a later phase if usage data justifies it -- see PRICING_OPTIONS.md's recommendation. Sells continuity (cloud save, version history, law-change alerts), never additional document access.

refundPolicy._note: Owner decision -- Step E. Not yet written.
